words.sense: difficult because it demands sustained effort
misconceptions: A task may be taxing without anyone unfairly imposing duties.

words.sense: burdensome because an obligation or demand weighs heavily
misconceptions: A duty can be oppressive even when it requires little physical effort.

semantic_axes.description: Arduous describes how much sustained effort something takes; onerous describes how heavily a demand or obligation burdens someone.

edges.boundary_rule: Arduous describes how much sustained effort something takes; onerous describes how heavily a demand or obligation burdens someone.

misconceptions.M1: A task may be taxing without anyone unfairly imposing duties.
misconceptions.M2: A duty can be oppressive even when it requires little physical effort.
misconceptions.M3: Do not stick with an old answer after decisive evidence changes, or let surface distractions override the boundary.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Layla’s task or obligation?

beats.text: Layla had to submit thirty separate forms every month or lose the room she was renting.
beats.reason: Disproportionate required duties weigh on the renter.

beats.text: The landlord accepted them through a convenient website.
beats.reason: Online submission does not remove the thirty-form monthly obligation.

chains.feedback_short: The key is an excessive compulsory paperwork obligation; online submission does not remove the thirty-form monthly obligation.
chains.feedback_deep: Arduous concerns difficult because it demands sustained effort; onerous concerns burdensome because an obligation or demand weighs heavily. Online submission does not remove the thirty-form monthly obligation.
chains.contrast_rule: Arduous: hours of exhausting effort; onerous: excessive required duties.

beats.text: Hugo climbed a steep trail for nine hours, stopping repeatedly to catch his breath.
